title: Leaving the Onyx scene to replace Teddy Wilson with Willie Bryant
summary: After Red McKenzie sang with the Spirits of Rhythm, Ramirez joined Willie Bryant's band in 1935, taking Teddy Wilson's place.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Oh, I didn't know that. But one thing you said was that Red McKenzie sang with the Spirits of Rhythm at the Onyx.
So what happened to Leo? I mean, he would still scat, I suppose, after Red had sung a chorus or something?

Well, I don't know. I left shortly... I think that's what I started joining Willie Bryant's band; I would say that. Yeah, I jumped up... Yeah, in Willie Bryant's band. Because that was '35... Yeah, that's pretty accurate. Teddy left the band, and I...
Oh, you took Teddy Wilson's place, that's right.
